outcome: length of stay in intensive care
cohort: 40 pregnant and postpartum women admitted to the intensive care unit with COVID-19 between August 1, 2021, and February 1, 2022
finding: The delta variant was associated with a greater mortality rate in pregnant and postpartum women admitted to the intensive care unit with COVID-19.
gest_age: The pregnant patients' median gestational week was 32 weeks and 2 days
